why: LLM-generated in the wild — Antigravity/Gemini dogfood output from design-starter-lab, a DIFFERENT generator family than the one the tell rules were tuned against. The corpus is otherwise made of pages this repo or its owner produced; without a foreign generator the rules can overfit to one model's slop. Origin: design-starter-lab/work/apple/design/preview/specimen.html, copied 2026-08-30, parity verified.
reviewNote: One finding, and it is a false positive with a counted mechanism. Worth a look because it is the same class as the repo's `-an`-in-a-comment scar.

verdicts.reason: Counted: the file contains EXACTLY ONE em dash (U+2014), and it sits inside a CSS comment — `/* ── Specimen chrome — every value resolves through the compiler */`. The rule reports five. Two mechanisms, either or both: it counts U+2500 box-drawing characters (`──`, used as a comment rule) as em dashes, and it reads text inside CSS comments as prose. This is the repo's own scar — a check matching the commentary rather than the thing — landing in a content rule instead of a test.
verdicts.message: 5 em dashes in 125 words (4.0 per 100) — a rate, not a choice
